papers.title: Introducing Geometry in Active Learning for Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: We propose an Active Learning approach to training a segmentation classifier that exploits geometric priors to streamline the annotation process in 3D image volumes. To this end, we use these priors not only to select voxels most in need of annotation but to guarantee that they lie on 2D planar patch, which makes it much easier to annotate than if they were randomly distributed in the volume. A simplified version of this approach is effective in natural 2D images. We evaluated our approach on Electron Microscopy and Magnetic Resonance image volumes, as well as on natural images. Comparing our approach against several accepted baselines demonstrates a marked performance increase.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注图像分割中的主动学习，与用户的研究方向（AI生物打印、髋关节植入物应力屏蔽、FEA替代模型、增材制造生物医学）无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses active learning for image segmentation, not surrogate modeling, design optimization, or finite element analysis, and lacks any connection to implant mechanics or biomedical FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出结合几何先验的主动学习方法来减少图像分割中的标注成本。
summary_zh.method: 利用几何先验选择二维平面上的体素进行标注。
summary_zh.result: 在电子显微镜和磁共振图像上展示了性能提升。
summary_zh.validation: 在多种3D和2D图像数据集上进行了实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce annotation effort in segmentation by exploiting geometric priors to select voxels on planar patches.
summary_en.method: An active learning strategy that incorporates geometry to query annotations on 2D planar patches.
summary_en.result: Achieved marked performance increase over baselines on EM, MR, and natural images.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on electron microscopy, magnetic resonance image volumes, and natural image datasets.

papers.title: Effect of Powder Particle Shape on the Properties of In Situ Ti–TiB Composite Materials Produced by Selective Laser Melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究粉末颗粒形状对SLM制备Ti-TiB复合材料性能的影响，未涉及生物医学植入体的应力遮挡或骨整合问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on the effect of powder shape on composite properties without any link to implant design, stress shielding, or biomedical application.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究粉末形状对SLM制备Ti-TiB复合材料性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 不同形状粉末进行SLM成型并测试性能
summary_zh.result: 粉末形状影响复合材料的致密度和力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 力学测试和微观结构表征

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of powder particle shape on the properties of in situ Ti-TiB composites produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Powders with different shapes were used for SLM processing, and the resulting composites were characterized.
summary_en.result: Powder shape significantly influenced the density and mechanical properties of the composites.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructural analysis were performed.

papers.title: Decarburization of stainless steel during selective laser melting and its influence on Young's modulus, hardness and tensile strength
papers.first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Materials Processing and Die & Mould Technology, School of Materials Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Xiao Zhao
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Materials Processing and Die & Mould Technology, School of Materials Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及不锈钢的SLM工艺和脱碳对力学性能的影响，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或生物医学植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous implant structures, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration for biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选择性激光熔化过程中不锈钢脱碳对其力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过调整SLM工艺参数诱导脱碳，测试力学性能变化
summary_zh.result: 脱碳降低弹性模量和硬度，但提高抗拉强度
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和硬度实验验证力学性能变化

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of decarburization during selective laser melting on the mechanical properties of stainless steel.
summary_en.method: Induced decarburization by varying SLM process parameters and characterized resulting mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Decarburization reduces Young's modulus and hardness while increasing tensile strength.
summary_en.validation: Validation via tensile and hardness testing of SLM-processed specimens.
